ielts_context: Speaking Part 1: daily routine; Writing Task 2: work-life balance
example_sentence_cn: 清晨的公园里总是有很多跑步者在锻炼。

example_sentence: The installation of CCTV cameras has been justified on the grounds of improving public security.
common_mistakes: security 和 safety 区别：security 强调免受故意伤害，safety 强调免受意外伤害
ielts_context: Reading: urban crime; Listening Section 3: city council debate
example_sentence_cn: 城市淡水资源的可持续管理对居民生活和经济发展至关重要。

example_sentence: Better street lighting has been demonstrated to reduce crime rates and improve pedestrian safety at night.
common_mistakes: lighting 不可数；street lights 指具体的灯（可数）
ielts_context: Speaking Part 3: neighbourhood safety; Listening Section 1: complaint
example_sentence_cn: 每个行政区都有自己的特色和文化底蕴。

example_sentence: The rental market in the city has become so competitive that prospective tenants routinely offer above the asking price.
common_mistakes: rental 可作形容词（租赁的）或名词（租金）
ielts_context: Writing Task 2: housing policy; Speaking Part 3: housing challenges
example_sentence_cn: 一个和谐友好的社区让居民感到安全和归属感。

example_sentence: Rural-to-urban migration has accelerated in developing countries as people seek better employment opportunities.
common_mistakes: migration 是不可数名词（作为过程）或集合名词
ielts_context: Reading: demographic studies; Writing Task 2: urbanization causes / effects
example_sentence_cn: 新开通的地铁线路将大大方便市民的日常通勤。

example_sentence: Higher levels of civic engagement are associated with stronger communities and more responsive local government.
common_mistakes: civic 是 civil 的同源词；civic 强调城市/公民事务，civil 更广泛
ielts_context: Reading: social studies / urban sociology; Writing Task 2: community / democracy
example_sentence_cn: 骑自行车不仅是环保的交通方式，还是很好的运动。

example_sentence: The shortage of parking spaces in the city centre has led to higher charges and increased use of public transport.
common_mistakes: parking space 可数；注意不要与 parking lot（停车场整体）混淆
ielts_context: Speaking Part 1: driving / transport; Listening Section 1: directions
example_sentence_cn: 城市应该为行人提供更多安全的步行空间和过街设施。

example_sentence: The city has approved the construction of several new high-rise residential buildings to address the housing shortage.
common_mistakes: residential 和 residence 区分：residence 是名词（住所），residential 是形容词
ielts_context: Speaking Part 1: accommodation; Listening Section 1: property viewing
example_sentence_cn: 良好的通风对于保持室内空气质量和预防霉菌至关重要。

example_sentence: As landfill sites reach capacity, cities must invest in recycling and waste-to-energy technologies.
common_mistakes: landfill 一个词；可数（指场地）或不可数（指处理方式）
ielts_context: Reading: waste management; Listening Section 4: environmental lecture
example_sentence_cn: 郊区的许多房屋使用化粪池系统来处理生活废水。

example_sentence: Installing more traffic cameras has led to a significant decrease in traffic violations at major intersections.
common_mistakes: violation 来自动词 violate；可数名词
ielts_context: Speaking Part 3: road safety; Listening Section 2: police announcement
example_sentence_cn: 确保所有居民都能获得干净的饮用水是城市的基本责任。

example_sentence: The proliferation of high-rise buildings has fundamentally altered the urban landscape of many Asian cities.
common_mistakes: landscape 可数；the urban landscape 指城市总体面貌
ielts_context: Writing Task 1: describing places; Speaking Part 3: hometown changes
example_sentence_cn: 这个夜市摊位卖着这座城市最好吃的街头小吃。

example_sentence: The city's historic district has been designated a UNESCO World Heritage site, attracting millions of tourists annually.
common_mistakes: heritage 不可数；a World Heritage site（可数，指具体地点）
ielts_context: Reading: tourism / culture; Listening Section 2: guided tour information
example_sentence_cn: 这座山为整个城市提供了壮丽的背景。

example_sentence: Flash flooding in the city is largely due to an outdated drainage system unable to cope with heavy rainfall.
common_mistakes: drainage 来自 drain（排水）；发音 /ˈdreɪnɪdʒ/
ielts_context: Reading: urban infrastructure; Listening Section 4: civil engineering lecture
example_sentence_cn: 一些老工业区经历了衰败，但正在通过城市更新项目重获新生。

example_sentence: Improper garbage disposal in rapidly growing cities poses serious health and environmental risks.
common_mistakes: garbage (US) / rubbish (UK) / waste（正式）；IELTS 三种均可
ielts_context: Writing Task 2: waste management; Speaking Part 3: environmental problems
example_sentence_cn: 了解一个城市的历史起源有助于理解其文化和建筑风格。

example_sentence: The council receives hundreds of noise complaints each year, mostly relating to late-night bars and construction work.
common_mistakes: complaint 是名词（投诉），complain 是动词；complaint about + 噪音来源
ielts_context: Speaking Part 3: neighbourhood problems; Listening Section 1: complaint form
example_sentence_cn: 这条宽阔的大道两旁种满了梧桐树，是城市最具标志性的街道之一。

example_sentence: Installing more signal-controlled pedestrian crossings near schools has improved safety for children.

example_sentence_cn: 许多工厂和物流中心都设在城市郊区，那里地价更便宜。

common_mistakes: installation 可数；指具体艺术作品时 a public art installation
ielts_context: Speaking Part 3: culture / public spaces; Listening Section 2: city festival
example_sentence_cn: 城市规划者正在努力重建这个历史街区昔日的辉煌。

example_sentence: Real estate developers have been accused of prioritizing profits over community needs and environmental considerations.
